verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a batch-job feature that runs large SQL operations as batches of retryable tasks, with live progress and pause, retry and cancel controls (docs-15). Cross-table partition operations move parts by reference rather than copying rows (docs-33), and bulk ingest works through INSERT, s3() and Kafka (docs-36). Agents can issue SQL over the official MCP server (docs-7), so bulk work is reachable from AI tooling. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and explicit documentation that agents can start and control batch jobs via MCP or an API.
